sunny.rule: every Pool of the Sunny sunny_pool_quarry program, its vendor mint (a Saber LP) and the Saber swap minting that LP (reserves a/b: [mint, reserve account])

friktion.rule: every VoltVault account (anchor discriminator) of the Friktion volt program

francium.rule: every lending pool (495-byte account) of the Francium lending program with its share (fToken) mint, and every lending reward pool that stakes one of those shares
